citation.title: FusionCLIP: Multimodal Contrastive Pretraining for Fusion Plasma Diagnostics
citation.authors: Q. Chen, X. Wang, Q. Yang, H. Si, Z. Yan, G. Xu, J. Tang
citation.venue: arXiv preprint (header lists IEEE Transactions, venue unspecified)

topic: Contrastive pretraining that pairs EAST visible-light video windows with 38 multi-rate diagnostic signals, evaluated on disruption prediction, ELM classification and H98 regression.
own_question: Does video-signal contrastive pretraining with visual token selection and a timestamp-aware query encoder improve downstream EAST diagnostic tasks compared with general-purpose pretrained backbones?
actual_method_and_evidence: The authors build EAST-MMD from 1307 discharges: 667 are used for pretraining and 640 for downstream tasks, with a discharge-level split of 447/96/97. Diagnostic variables keep their original timestamps. A Temporal Query Encoder uses 25 time queries per 50 ms window and a time-distance attention bias. They report an aggregate Joint score of 89.07%, plus ablations. The work uses one device and does not involve CES, ion temperature, BES/ECEI or nowcasting of reported values.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Multi-rate fusion diagnostic signals have been encoded using their original observation timestamps rather than by resampling onto a fixed grid, for example with time-query attention in a learned representation model on EAST.
claim_checks.original_pdf_locator: Sec. II-A and Sec. II-D, Eqs. (8)-(10)
claim_checks.qualification: This describes the authors' design, not a demonstration that it is superior for our task. Its scope is EAST, offline, and the targets are video, disruption, ELM and H98, not CES.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Inputs are 50 ms windows with a 2 ms stride. Disruption alarms are evaluated causally in chronological order. Real-time latency is not reported. H98 is computed offline from EFIT and used as a target only.
validation_if_relevant: Single split by discharge on one device, with no external data. Thresholds are selected on the validation set.
forbidden_inferences: Do not claim relevance to CES, Ti, or KSTAR.
Do not treat the TQE as validated for our signals.
Do not generalize these results to all fusion machine learning work.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: At most an optional citation for timestamp-aware handling of asynchronous diagnostics. The device, task and modalities do not match our paper, so it is not needed.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
